t: What Does The Name Remonda Mean?
s: Remonda is a feminine given name most commonly understood as a variant of Raymond/Raimund, ultimately from the Germanic elements ragin (counsel, advice) and mund (protector, guardian), yielding the sense “wise protector” or “protector through counsel.” In many languages, the masculine forms-Raymond (English/French), Raimund (German), Ramón (Spanish), and Raimondo (Italian)-have corresponding feminine forms: Raimonda/Raimonda (Italian/Latvian/Lithuanian), Raimunda (Portuguese/Spanish), Raymonde (French), Ramona (widely used in Spanish, Catalan, Romanian, and English), and the Arabic-influenced Remonda/Remonda (found in Levantine and Egyptian contexts), where the vowel shift to “e” reflects local phonology and orthography.
